'''Voltazar''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Nekowatt]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Thunderpaw]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Humans often say that peace of mind makes for a healthy body, and Voltazar could not agree more. Only the finest food and softest bedding are allowed, and back comfort is totally non-negotiable even on the battleground."

Voltazar is a red rarity Tatari.

==Evolution Trial==
Voltazar's evolution trial unlocks when it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Thunderpaw]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Marathon Party]] (Use boards x6000) or [[Fishing Contest]] (Use Fishing Rod x6000).
* Launch 40,000 pinballs or unlock [[Cinderclaw]]'s codex.

==Strategy==
[[File:Voltazar Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Voltazar's attack range]]
You should use [[Flameow]]/evo alongside Voltazar because of the Paw Pals bond, giving Voltazar a 3% ATK speed increase. In stages with hordes of regular Zobos, Voltazar could hold one lane.

When Voltazar's skill cooldown reaches minimum, its attack range increases by 1 tile.
{{clear|left}}

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Nobody knows how Voltazar's carpet flies, but it isn't trademarked, so... up, up, and away!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Rides a magical mat that allows one to fly in the air. Overreliance on the mat has reduced exercise, however, so Voltazar seems to be getting bigger and bigger."
